# Quantitative research test fixture

The focused test runner creates a minimal base and thesis overlay in a temporary directory from the public values in `expected.psd1`. The fixture uses synthetic declarations, one-line locks, an inert OpenBB reference file, a fake `uv.cmd`, and placeholder protected content.

It contains no provider credential, research dataset, downloaded package, or virtual environment. The string placed in `.env.local` is a test-only placeholder used to prove that reconciliation preserves and does not publish credentials.
